inventory_mapping_caution: Original variation-source suggestion rows remain unchanged andprovisional. They do not establish thatFaraday/Jung document every Artemidorus/Freudian rule;use the correct ranked original source for each future profile.
tradition_boundary: Artemidorus historical omens/taxonomy,Freudian psychoanalytic theory,Jungian collaborators,modern diary practices andcultural dictionaries are separate source schools. Historical interpretations,dreamer associations andeditorial reflection never establish factual prediction orclinical diagnosis.

feasibility.first_scope: One named,source-verified limited historical taxonomy/context reference combined withstructured voluntary journaling. Prefer Artemidorus1.1/1.2/1.8/1.9 after exact terminology/rights/fixture freeze,optionally a small complete rights-cleared motif subset. Taxonomy labels andcontextual questions give more than generic summaries without inventing a universal symbol table.
feasibility.context: Preserve raw narrative andoptional user-supplied circumstances/associations. Historical requests for identity,occupation,health/status are source facts,not application requirements;missing context remains unknown andmust not trigger defaults orstereotypes.
feasibility.narrative_tagging: Possible deterministic literal motif/tag rules must have versioned vocabularies,exact matched spans,language/case/Unicode conventions andindependent fixtures. Tags describe recorded text only;they cannot identify latent meaning,memories,diagnosis orfuture outcomes. No NLP framework orLLM required.
feasibility.rights: Ancient text,modern English translation,critical edition,website andillustrations have separate rights. Attalus usesWhite1975/Lewis1976 excerpts withoutverified corpus permission;PG Brill1913 hasUSA-public-domain scope. Faraday/Jung stay metadata-only until legitimate method access/rights.
feasibility.privacy: Voluntary local/offline journal andoptional context only. Preserve omissions/empty dreams/raw associations andexplicit uncertainty. No unsolicited data collection,mandatory identity orautomatic sharing.
feasibility.interpretation: Direct source taxonomy/conditional reference,user associations,editorial reflection andunsupported conclusions remain separate. Unsupported contexts orconflicting schools cannot silently resolve into a prediction.
